about_the_game:
Tech Division is a top-down shooter with light RTS elements. You play as Simone, an Aerolite engineer, who can build and control a squad of bots. Battle through swarms of enemy Wrikes who have a diverse set of their own abilities. Simone must use his resources and experience to get through the relentless Wrike factions and reunite with his friends.

The Story:

Simone has been tasked with using his robots to cut through a jungle now at war. His goal, a downed spaceship that was shot down by the enemy. While Simone is not usually someone who would take on such a perilous task, his colleagues... friends were on the ship when it went down. There is a chance that the Wrikes haven't gotten to them yet and Simone could save them! Also it helps that Simone is the only one who really understands the robots he has been working on, robots that can be used to fight the Wrikes! And while Simone is quite worried, he has Commander Karoma to keep a watchful eye on him to make sure he makes it there safe and sound.

Gameplay:
While Simone has his own weapon there are a slew of Wrikes after him. You can utilize his bots in various ways to help defeat them!

  • Command bots to points on the field and watch them attack Wrikes

  • Utilize the Blast ability to chop them down faster

  • Build more bots so you don't become overwhelmed

  • Utilize the Barricade ability to create a moving forcefield around the bots, watch out, it doesn't least forever.

As you go through the level you will be able to pick up resources to help you upgrade Simon's and the Bot's abilites!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel dual-core or Apple Silicon (M1)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 900 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs at 1080p, 30 FPS
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M2/M3) or Intel i5/i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated GPU or dedicated Metal-compatible GPU
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Retina/4K displays, 60 FPS+

short_description: Play as Simone! Build and command your squad of bots on the field. Battle through swarms of enemy Wrikes who have a diverse set of their own abilities. Use resources and upgrades to get through the relentless Wrike factions to reunite with your friends! Hopefully you are not too late.
